KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /dh/ na /th/.

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
